name: Daylight 100
notes: Travel, daylight and foliage. Clean color, fine grain, open shadows and bright whites.

name: Portrait 160
notes: People and window light. Soft highlight shoulders and restrained reds keep skin gentle.

name: Gold 200
notes: Late afternoon and backlight. Warm highlights, full midtones and lively yellows.

name: Pastel 400
notes: Overcast scenes and light clothing. Gentle contrast, soft greens and pale highlights.

name: Street 400
notes: Street scenes and hard sunlight. Firm shadows, strong midtones, and textured grain.

name: Tungsten 800
notes: Available light at night. Cool ambient color, coarse grain and warm halos around lamps.

name: Mono 100
notes: Architecture and still life. Fine silver grain and a smooth progression into white.

name: Mono 400
notes: Documentary black and white. Weighty blacks, brighter midtones and pronounced grain.

name: Fade 400
notes: Quiet scenes and vintage color. Lifted blacks, subdued saturation and compressed whites.

name: Cinema 500
notes: Mixed light and high-contrast scenes. Dense, cool shadows and soft, warm highlight separation.
